source_text: Opponents' arguments, often emphasizing ethical concerns over consent for minors or unsubstantiated risks of psychological trauma, have been characterized as relying on low-quality evidence, such as ecological studies or anecdotal reports, while disregarding the causal mechanisms—reduced epithelial surface area and Langerhans cells vulnerable to HIV—supported by histological and virological data. [128]
